units.source_text: 然而，事到如今，对局条件改变了。

en.t: However, by now the conditions of the match had changed.

units.source_text: 在对手大竹七段来说，这是重大的事。

en.t: For his opponent, seventh-dan Otake, this was a serious matter.

units.source_text: 如果无法依照当初的协议进行，名人可以放弃这盘棋。

en.t: If the game could not proceed according to the original agreement, the Meijin could abandon this match.

units.source_text: 但名人毕竟没有那样讲，只是说：

en.t: But in the end, the Meijin did not say that; he merely said:
